Ana (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — finalizing run + swag plan for the joint webinar with CloudWave & NodeLabs next Thu. Need a quick sync on speaker order, 10-min hands-on demo slots, and swag drop timing.
Devon (Events): I'm free 30m after standup to walk the run. Do we have firm speaker confirmations?
Ana (Partnerships): CloudWave confirmed Maya (ML Eng) and NodeLabs confirmed Omar. Redwood speakers: Ravi (solutions) + Sam (field ops).
Ravi (Solutions): I can do a 10-min 'integration flow' live demo. Plan to use a pre-recorded fallback in case GPU pool is flaky.
Lidia (Marketing): Swag list: stickers + 2 styles of tees + partner co-branded notebooks. How many attendee freebies vs speaker gifts?
Sam (Field Ops): For in-person pickup at booth: 300 attendee packs, 8 speaker swag boxes (shipping labels ready). For virtual registrants — we'll run a giveaway post-event.
Devon (Events): Run of show draft (suggested):
```
17:45 - Doors / waiting room - sponsor slides loop
18:00 - Welcome (Ana) - 5m
18:05 - CloudWave keynote (Maya) - 10m
18:15 - NodeLabs demo (Omar) - 10m
18:25 - Redwood deep dive (Ravi) - 10m
18:35 - Hands-on quick labs (Sam) - 10m
18:45 - Live Q&A + poll - 10m
18:55 - Close + next steps (Lidia) - 5m
```
Lidia (Marketing): Can we swap the Redwood deep dive before NodeLabs? Omar wants to demo a hardware fallthrough that might need more time.
Ana (Partnerships): We can do that — new order: CloudWave, Ravi, Omar, Sam hands-on. Need buy-in from speakers. @Ravi @Omar (cc NodeLabs)
Ravi (Solutions): Works for me. I'll shorten one slide to keep total slot to 10m.
Sam (Field Ops): Hands-on will be 2 quick guided prompts + a sanity-check script. If the dedicated GPUs are busy, fallback to the quantized local demo. I'll post the fallback command in a minute.
Devon (Events): AV notes — OBS scene names: Lobby, Keynote, Demo-Ravi, Demo-Omar, Hands-On, Q&A. Can someone confirm we have scenes and lower-third assets?
Ana (Partnerships): @Lidia can you confirm lower-thirds and partner logos? Also need partner-approved speaker headshots by Tue EOD.
Lidia (Marketing): Got it. I'll chase logos + headshots. Recommend we use co-branded slide footer: "Presented by Redwood Inference + CloudWave + NodeLabs"
Sam (Field Ops): Fallback command (for hands-on if cluster down):
```bash
# start quantized local runtime
./start_local_inference --model redwood-quant-v1 --port 8080 --kv-cache off --batch-size 1
# demo script
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Translate: Hello ->"}'
```
Ravi (Solutions): I'll prep a trimmed prompt set and upload to the shared drive. Link: https://drive.redwood/repo/webinar/prompts
Devon (Events): Swag timing: booth pickup opens at 17:30, speaker swag delivered to green room at 16:00. For virtual giveaway, Lidia — can you prepare the promo code flow?
Lidia (Marketing): Yup. Promo code flow OK. Also propose a post-webinar email with a 20% partner coupon and a swag raffle CTA. I'll draft and share by Wed.
Ana (Partnerships): Customs/shipping note: Sam — please confirm any international kits flagged for customs. We had one delayed last time.
Sam (Field Ops): Sent the manifest to logistics. Two EU boxes flagged for extra docs — carrier needs commercial invoice by Tue noon. I can attach once Lidia confirms branding on invoice.
Ravi (Solutions): Tech checklist: test run with CloudWave on Wed 11:00 PT. Can we all join?
Ana (Partnerships): Wed 11:00 PT confirmed. Please add deploy-bot to the rehearsal so we can capture deploy logs.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal starting Wed 11:00 PT -> https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (auto-post to #partnerships 10m prior) :robot_face:
Devon (Events): Final ask — can someone draft 1-slide speaker intro blurbs (30 words each)? I'll assemble the keynote slides.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll post mine in the drive under /bios.
Lidia (Marketing): I'll write partner blurbs and share for quick approval.
Ana (Partnerships): Great. Action items summary: 1) Speakers to send headshots & blurbs (by Tue EOD) 2) Sam to finalize fallback & logistics (Tue noon) 3) Lidia to finalize email + swag invoice branding (Wed morning) 4) Rehearsal Wed 11:00 PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
